endorsements.description: Chris Goggans , Security Design International Kevin McPeake , Trust Factory Wouter Aukema , Trust Factory Lotus Notes/Domino Security This session will cover security vulnerabilties and common misconfigurations in Lotus Notes and Domino servers. The presentation will contain exploit demonstrations and discuss work-arounds for the problems. This session will also announce the results of research into new vulnerabilties.
